title: Coherent Hom transformations are compatible with composition of functors
statement:
Use small quasicategories, right-pinched mapping spaces, coherent functors and transformations of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the space category of [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces], and the Hom bifunctors and single-functor transformations of [lem-coef-infinity-hom-bifunctor-functoriality]. Write $K_C=C^{\mathrm{op}}\times C$. Normalize a Hom bifunctor $H_C:K_C\to\mathcal S$ as the classifier of the twisted-arrow left fibration $\lambda_C:\operatorname{Tw}(C)\to K_C$ of [lem-coef-twisted-arrow-left-fibration], using the composition- and base-pullback-compatible transport comparison of [lem-coef-space-transport-classification]. Then the Hom functors and their transformations can be chosen simultaneously on any small strict ordinary diagram of small quasicategories so that the following holds.

For every functor $T:C\to D$, the transformation $t_T:H_C\to H_D(T^{\mathrm{op}}\times T)$ is represented under classification by the map $\operatorname{Tw}(C)\to K_C\times_{K_D}\operatorname{Tw}(D)$ sending a simplex $\sigma$ to $T\sigma$. Its components, in the right-pinched mapping-space models, are the actual maps $T_{x,y}$ obtained by applying $T$ to simplices. The identity transformation is normalized to the identity. For composable functors $T:C\to D$ and $U:D\to F$, there is a specified coherent comparison from $t_{UT}$ to the composite of $t_T$ with the restriction of $t_U$. Its components are constant homotopies on the strict equalities $(UT)_{x,y}=U_{Tx,Ty}T_{x,y}$. For an edge $h:y\to z$ and vertex $x$ of $C$, write $c_C(h)$ for the chosen postcomposition representative and write $h_T$ for the naturality homotopy
$$T_{x,z}c_C(h)\simeq c_D(Th)T_{x,y}.$$
The comparison supplies a homotopy relative endpoints between $h_{UT}$ and the pasted path
$$U_{Tx,Tz}T_{x,z}c_C(h)\xrightarrow{\ U h_T\ }U_{Tx,Tz}c_D(Th)T_{x,y}\xrightarrow{\ h_U T\ }c_F(UTh)U_{Tx,Ty}T_{x,y}.$$
If two composites in the strict diagram are equal as simplicial maps, their $t_{UT}$ and $h_{UT}$ are the same chosen data. The comparisons obey the unit and associativity coherences and their higher simplices in the relevant functor infinity categories. Representatives of postcomposition are chosen from the Hom action; arbitrary independently prescribed naturality homotopies are not asserted to satisfy this normalization.

source.place: Kerodon Corollary 8.3.5.8 (046J), Remark 8.3.5.9 (03PD), and Proposition 8.3.5.6 (03N3); the normalization and composition coherence are an agent-formulated refinement using twisted-arrow classification, not a verbatim clause of 046J. Proposition 7.3.6.1 (0309) gives the full mapping-space universal property. These are Kerodon identifiers, not Stacks tags; no Stacks tag states this quasicategorical result. Read online; archival copies WANTED.
